My friend and I had just purchased a 'tener' or one sixteenth of an ounce of pure 'ice' or methamphetamine.
We are schooled users but this time i decided that we should drink from the herculean cup by loading up a half gram each into a syringe and climbing to the top of the mountain. He took his first and proceeded outside to make grass angels in the hot Oklahoma sun. I took mine into the restroom, drew it back and let it all loose.
Instantly I had a ringing in my ears and began sweating profusely. Lost use of my legs and crawled outside to gather my friend inside of our air conditioning. I then laid on the floor and watched the ceiling and carpet bubble as if it were boiling water. The rest is a blank.
